component.name: ActivityTrack
component.summary: Running activities and to-dos of ActivityTrack, from the tray
Attività in corso e Da fare di ActivityTrack, dall'area di notifica

description.p: ActivityTrack Desktop keeps the running activities and the to-dos of the ActivityTrack app a click away from the system tray, so that an activity goes in from the keyboard instead of the phone.
It is paired with the organisation's ActivityTrack Web server like a phone and syncs both ways; without a network it keeps working and syncs when the network is back.
